products.title: Multi-Purpose Stainless Steel Hanging Clips（10Pcs）
products.body_html:
<style>
/* =========================================================
   STAINLESS STEEL HANGING CLIP HOOKS
   SHOPIFY CRO PRODUCT PAGE
   MOBILE FIRST / LARGE READABLE TYPE
========================================================= */

.hook-clip-page,
.hook-clip-page *{
    box-sizing:border-box;
}

.hook-clip-page{
    --hc-blue:#748FA4;
    --hc-blue-dark:#4D687B;
    --hc-blue-light:#EEF4F7;

    --hc-green:#78937D;
    --hc-green-light:#EEF5EF;

    --hc-yellow:#D4A54C;
    --hc-yellow-light:#FFF6DF;

    --hc-warm:#F8F4EE;
    --hc-gray:#F4F5F5;

    --hc-text:#363A3C;
    --hc-muted:#697175;
    --hc-border:#DFE4E6;
    --hc-white:#FFFFFF;

    --hc-shadow:
    0 10px 28px rgba(48,56,60,.07);

    width:100%;
    max-width:1440px;

    margin:0 auto;

    overflow:hidden;

    background:#fff;

    color:var(--hc-text);

    font-family:
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    Helvetica,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;

    line-height:1.55;
}

.hook-clip-page img{
    display:block;

    width:100%;
    max-width:100%;
    height:auto;

    object-fit:contain;
}

.hook-clip-page a{
    text-decoration:none;
}

.hc-container{
    width:100%;
    max-width:1120px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.hc-section{
    padding:54px 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   COMMON HEADINGS
========================================================= */

.hc-heading{
    max-width:860px;

    margin:0 auto 28px;

    text-align:center;
}

.hc-eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:10px;

    padding:7px 14px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:var(--hc-blue-light);

    color:var(--hc-blue-dark);

    font-size:12px;

    font-weight:900;

    letter-spacing:1px;

    text-transform:uppercase;
}

.hc-title{
    margin:0 0 12px;

    font-size:36px;

    line-height:1.08;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.hc-title span{
    color:var(--hc-blue-dark);
}

.hc-description{
    max-width:760px;

    margin:0 auto;

    color:var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:15px;

    line-height:1.65;
}


/* =========================================================
   BUTTON
========================================================= */

.hc-btn{
    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    min-height:54px;

    padding:0 34px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--hc-blue),
        var(--hc-blue-dark)
    );

    color:#fff !important;

    font-size:15px;

    font-weight:950;

    box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px rgba(77,104,123,.28);

    transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.hc-btn:hover{
    transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

    box-shadow:
    0 17px 38px rgba(77,104,123,.36);
}

.hc-btn:active{
    transform:scale(.95);
}


/* =========================================================
   01 HERO
========================================================= */

.hc-hero{
    padding:64px 20px 52px;

    text-align:center;

    background:
    radial-gradient(
        circle at 10% 15%,
        rgba(212,165,76,.18),
        transparent 30%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
        circle at 90% 18%,
        rgba(116,143,164,.20),
        transparent 30%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
        140deg,
        #FFFDF8,
        #F4F8FA
    );
}

.hc-hero-inner{
    max-width:1060px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.hc-badge{
    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:15px;

    padding:8px 16px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    rgba(116,143,164,.12);

    border:
    1px solid rgba(77,104,123,.18);

    color:var(--hc-blue-dark);

    font-size:11px;

    font-weight:900;

    letter-spacing:.7px;
}

.hc-hero h1{
    max-width:960px;

    margin:0 auto;

    font-size:
    clamp(40px,5vw,62px);

    line-height:1.02;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-1.6px;
}

.hc-hero h1 span{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--hc-blue-dark),
        var(--hc-blue),
        var(--hc-green)
    );

    -webkit-background-clip:text;

    background-clip:text;

    color:transparent;
}

.hc-hero-text{
    max-width:790px;

    margin:
    18px auto 22px;

    color:var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.65;
}

.hc-hero-highlights{
    display:flex;

    flex-wrap:wrap;

    justify-content:center;

    gap:7px;

    margin-bottom:24px;
}

.hc-hero-highlights span{
    padding:7px 11px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.92);

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    color:var(--hc-blue-dark);

    font-size:12px;

    font-weight:850;
}

.hc-hero-image{
    max-width:960px;

    margin:0 auto;

    padding:7px;

    border-radius:22px;

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(116,143,164,.34),
        rgba(120,147,125,.22)
    );

    box-shadow:
    0 23px 56px
    rgba(48,56,60,.13);

    overflow:hidden;
}

.hc-hero-image img{
    border-radius:16px;
}


/* HERO TRUST */

.hc-trust-strip{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:8px;

    max-width:960px;

    margin:
    14px auto 0;
}

.hc-trust-item{
    padding:
    11px 8px;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.90);

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    color:
    var(--hc-text);

    font-size:12px;

    line-height:1.35;

    font-weight:850;
}


/* =========================================================
   02 CLICKABLE CORE FEATURE NAV
========================================================= */

.hc-nav{
    background:#fff;
}

.hc-nav-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:12px;

    max-width:980px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.hc-nav-card{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    gap:12px;

    min-width:0;

    padding:17px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    border-radius:17px;

    color:
    var(--hc-text);

    box-shadow:
    var(--hc-shadow);

    transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.hc-nav-card:nth-child(1){
    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);
}

.hc-nav-card:nth-child(2){
    background:
    var(--hc-green-light);
}

.hc-nav-card:nth-child(3){
    background:
    var(--hc-yellow-light);
}

.hc-nav-card:nth-child(4){
    background:
    var(--hc-gray);
}

.hc-nav-card:nth-child(5){
    grid-column:
    1 / -1;

    background:
    var(--hc-warm);
}

.hc-nav-card:hover{
    transform:
    translateY(-3px);

    box-shadow:
    0 14px 32px
    rgba(48,56,60,.10);
}

.hc-nav-icon{
    width:44px;
    height:44px;

    flex:none;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    border-radius:13px;

    background:#fff;

    font-size:21px;
}

.hc-nav-copy{
    min-width:0;
}

.hc-nav-copy strong{
    display:block;

    margin-bottom:3px;

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.25;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-nav-copy span{
    display:block;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:13px;

    line-height:1.4;
}


/* =========================================================
   03 FIVE FEATURE DETAILS
   FIRST LARGE + NEXT FOUR 2x2
========================================================= */

.hc-details{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--hc-warm),
        #FFFFFF
    );
}

.hc-feature-list{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:14px;

    max-width:980px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.hc-feature-card{
    min-width:0;

    padding:20px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    border-radius:20px;

    background:#fff;

    box-shadow:
    var(--hc-shadow);

    scroll-margin-top:20px;
}

.hc-feature-card:first-child{
    grid-column:
    1 / -1;

    padding:22px;
}

.hc-feature-card:nth-child(2){
    background:
    var(--hc-green-light);
}

.hc-feature-card:nth-child(3){
    background:
    var(--hc-yellow-light);
}

.hc-feature-card:nth-child(4){
    background:
    var(--hc-gray);
}

.hc-feature-card:nth-child(5){
    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);
}

.hc-feature-image{
    margin-bottom:16px;

    overflow:hidden;

    border-radius:15px;

    background:#fff;
}

.hc-feature-image img{
    border-radius:12px;
}

.hc-feature-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 7px;

    font-size:20px;

    line-height:1.28;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-feature-card:first-child h3{
    font-size:24px;
}

.hc-feature-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.56;
}

.hc-points{
    margin:
    11px 0 0;

    padding:0;

    list-style:none;
}

.hc-points li{
    margin-bottom:6px;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   HOW IT WORKS
========================================================= */

.hc-how{
    max-width:980px;

    margin:
    20px auto 0;

    padding:18px;

    border-radius:18px;

    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);

    border:
    1px solid rgba(116,143,164,.18);
}

.hc-how h3{
    margin:
    0 0 14px;

    text-align:center;

    font-size:21px;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-step-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:9px;
}

.hc-step{
    padding:14px;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:#fff;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.52;
}

.hc-step-number{
    width:30px;
    height:30px;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:8px;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:
    var(--hc-yellow-light);

    color:
    #9B731B;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-step strong{
    display:block;

    margin-bottom:4px;

    color:
    var(--hc-blue-dark);
}


/* =========================================================
   04 FEATURE SUMMARY + PRODUCT INFORMATION
========================================================= */

.hc-info{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        #FFFFFF,
        var(--hc-gray)
    );
}

.hc-info-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:14px;

    max-width:940px;

    margin:
    0 auto 28px;
}

.hc-info-card{
    min-width:0;

    padding:18px;

    border-radius:16px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px
    rgba(48,56,60,.045);
}

.hc-info-card:nth-child(1){
    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);
}

.hc-info-card:nth-child(2){
    background:
    var(--hc-green-light);
}

.hc-info-card:nth-child(3){
    background:
    var(--hc-yellow-light);
}

.hc-info-card:nth-child(4){
    background:
    var(--hc-warm);
}

.hc-info-icon{
    width:42px;
    height:42px;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:9px;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:#fff;

    font-size:20px;
}

.hc-info-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 7px;

    font-size:17px;

    line-height:1.3;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-info-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.53;
}


/* PRODUCT INFORMATION */

.hc-product-info-heading{
    max-width:940px;

    margin:
    0 auto 18px;

    text-align:left;
}

.hc-product-info-heading .hc-eyebrow{
    margin-bottom:8px;
}

.hc-product-info-heading h2{
    margin:
    0 0 8px;

    font-size:30px;

    line-height:1.12;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-.6px;
}

.hc-product-info-heading h2 span{
    color:
    var(--hc-blue-dark);
}

.hc-product-info-heading p{
    max-width:700px;

    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:15px;

    line-height:1.6;
}


/* =========================================================
   SPECS
========================================================= */

.hc-spec-box{
    max-width:940px;

    margin:0 auto;

    padding:9px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    border-radius:18px;

    background:#fff;

    box-shadow:
    var(--hc-shadow);
}

.hc-spec-row{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    34% 66%;

    margin-bottom:6px;

    overflow:hidden;

    border-radius:10px;

    border:
    1px solid rgba(116,143,164,.17);
}

.hc-spec-row:last-child{
    margin-bottom:0;
}

.hc-spec-label{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    padding:
    12px 14px;

    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);

    color:
    var(--hc-blue-dark);

    font-size:13px;

    line-height:1.45;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-spec-value{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    padding:
    12px 14px;

    background:#fff;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:13px;

    line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 FAQ
========================================================= */

.hc-faq{
    background:#fff;
}

.hc-faq-list{
    max-width:920px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.hc-faq details{
    margin-bottom:8px;

    overflow:hidden;

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    border-radius:13px;

    background:#fff;

    transition:
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.hc-faq details[open]{
    box-shadow:
    0 8px 24px
    rgba(48,56,60,.06);
}

.hc-faq summary{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;

    gap:14px;

    padding:
    16px 18px;

    cursor:pointer;

    list-style:none;

    color:
    var(--hc-text);

    font-size:15px;

    line-height:1.4;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
    display:none;
}

.hc-faq summary::after{
    content:"⌄";

    width:28px;
    height:28px;

    flex:none;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);

    color:
    var(--hc-blue-dark);

    transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.hc-faq details[open] summary::after{
    transform:
    rotate(180deg);

    background:
    var(--hc-blue);

    color:#fff;
}

.hc-faq-answer{
    padding:
    0 18px 17px;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.62;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.hc-guarantees{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--hc-gray),
        #FFFFFF
    );
}

.hc-guarantee-list{
    display:flex;

    flex-direction:column;

    gap:10px;

    max-width:900px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.hc-guarantee-card{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    gap:14px;

    padding:
    16px 18px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--hc-border);

    border-radius:16px;

    background:#fff;

    box-shadow:
    var(--hc-shadow);
}

.hc-guarantee-icon{
    width:46px;
    height:46px;

    flex:none;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    border-radius:13px;

    background:
    var(--hc-blue-light);

    font-size:21px;
}

.hc-guarantee-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 4px;

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.3;

    font-weight:950;
}

.hc-guarantee-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--hc-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.hc-cta{
    padding:
    64px 20px;

    text-align:center;

    color:#fff;

    background:
    radial-gradient(
        circle at 15% 20%,
        rgba(212,165,76,.22),
        transparent 30%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
        circle at 85% 80%,
        rgba(116,143,164,.36),
        transparent 30%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        #516C7D,
        #344A57
    );
}

.hc-cta h2{
    margin:
    0 0 12px;

    font-size:40px;

    line-height:1.07;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.hc-cta h2 span{
    color:#FFE3A6;
}

.hc-cta p{
    max-width:720px;

    margin:
    0 auto 22px;

    color:
    rgba(255,255,255,.89);

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.58;
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOATING BUY NOW
========================================================= */

.hc-floating-buy{
    position:fixed;

    right:18px;
    bottom:18px;

    z-index:99999;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    min-height:50px;

    padding:0 24px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--hc-blue),
        var(--hc-blue-dark)
    );

    color:#fff !important;

    font-size:14px;

    font-weight:950;

    box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px
    rgba(77,104,123,.34);

    transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;

    -webkit-tap-highlight-color:
    transparent;
}

.hc-floating-buy:hover{
    transform:
    translateY(-4px)
    scale(1.03);
}

.hc-floating-buy:active{
    transform:
    scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
========================================================= */

@media(max-width:700px){

    .hc-section{
        padding:
        38px 14px;
    }

    .hc-heading{
        margin-bottom:22px;
    }

    .hc-eyebrow{
        font-size:12px;

        line-height:1.35;
    }

    .hc-title{
        font-size:32px;

        line-height:1.09;
    }

    .hc-description{
        font-size:16px;

        line-height:1.6;
    }


    /* HERO */

    .hc-hero{
        padding:
        43px 14px 35px;
    }

    .hc-badge{
        font-size:11px;
    }

    .hc-hero h1{
        font-size:42px;

        line-height:1.03;

        letter-spacing:-1.2px;
    }

    .hc-hero-text{
        margin:
        15px auto 19px;

        font-size:17px;

        line-height:1.6;
    }

    .hc-hero-highlights{
        gap:6px;

        margin-bottom:19px;
    }

    .hc-hero-highlights span{
        padding:
        6px 8px;

        font-size:11px;

        line-height:1.35;
    }

    .hc-trust-strip{
        grid-template-columns:
        repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

        gap:7px;

        margin-top:10px;
    }

    .hc-trust-item{
        padding:
        9px 6px;

        font-size:11px;
    }


    /* CLICK NAV 2x2 */

    .hc-nav-grid{
        grid-template-columns:
        repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

        gap:9px;
    }

    .hc-nav-card{
        align-items:flex-start;

        gap:8px;

        padding:
        12px 9px;
    }

    .hc-nav-card:nth-child(5){
        grid-column:
        1 / -1;
    }

    .hc-nav-icon{
        width:36px;
        height:36px;

        font-size:17px;
    }

    .hc-nav-copy strong{
        font-size:15px;

        line-height:1.25;
    }

    .hc-nav-copy span{
        font-size:13px;

        line-height:1.4;
    }


    /* FEATURE DETAILS */

    .hc-feature-list{
        grid-template-columns:
        repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

        gap:9px;
    }

    .hc-feature-card{
        padding:
        12px 10px;
    }

    .hc-feature-card:first-child{
        grid-column:
        1 / -1;

        padding:14px;
    }

    .hc-feature-card h3{
        font-size:16px;

        line-height:1.28;
    }

    .hc-feature-card:first-child h3{

/* =========================================================
   10 FAQ
========================================================= */

.snl-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #f4f9fa 0%,
      #eef5f0 100%
    );
}

.snl-faq-list{
  max-width:930px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.snl-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #d8e1e5;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 10px rgba(33,65,79,.035);
}

.snl-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.snl-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;

  padding:14px 16px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.snl-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.snl-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 27px;

  width:27px;
  height:27px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--blue-dark);
  background:var(--blue-soft);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.snl-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--blue-dark);
}

.snl-faq-answer{
  padding:0 16px 14px;

  color:#69757b;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.button-hook-page *{
    box-sizing:border-box;
}

.button-hook-page{
    --bh-blue:#6F94B2;
    --bh-blue-dark:#456A86;
    --bh-blue-light:#EEF5F9;

    --bh-gray:#7A8085;
    --bh-gray-light:#F2F3F4;

    --bh-green:#7E9A84;
    --bh-green-light:#EFF6F0;

    --bh-warm:#FAF7F2;

    --bh-gold:#C99A45;
    --bh-gold-light:#FFF6E2;

    --bh-text:#34383A;
    --bh-muted:#687177;
    --bh-border:#DFE5E7;
    --bh-white:#FFFFFF;

    --bh-shadow:
    0 10px 28px rgba(51,60,65,.07);

    width:100%;
    max-width:1440px;

    margin:0 auto;

    overflow:hidden;

    background:#fff;

    color:var(--bh-text);

    font-family:
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    Helvetica,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;

    line-height:1.55;
}

.button-hook-page img{
    display:block;

    width:100%;
    max-width:100%;
    height:auto;

    object-fit:contain;
}

.button-hook-page a{
    text-decoration:none;
}

.bh-container{
    width:100%;
    max-width:1120px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-section{
    padding:54px 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   COMMON HEADINGS
========================================================= */

.bh-heading{
    max-width:860px;

    margin:0 auto 28px;

    text-align:center;
}

.bh-eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:10px;

    padding:7px 14px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:var(--bh-blue-light);

    color:var(--bh-blue-dark);

    font-size:12px;

    font-weight:900;

    letter-spacing:1px;

    text-transform:uppercase;
}

.bh-title{
    margin:0 0 12px;

    font-size:36px;

    line-height:1.08;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.bh-title span{
    color:var(--bh-blue-dark);
}

.bh-description{
    max-width:760px;

    margin:0 auto;

    color:var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:15px;

    line-height:1.65;
}


/* =========================================================
   BUTTON
========================================================= */

.bh-btn{
    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    min-height:54px;

    padding:0 34px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--bh-blue),
        var(--bh-blue-dark)
    );

    color:#fff !important;

    font-size:15px;

    font-weight:950;

    box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px rgba(69,106,134,.28);

    transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.bh-btn:hover{
    transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

    box-shadow:
    0 17px 38px rgba(69,106,134,.36);
}

.bh-btn:active{
    transform:scale(.95);
}


/* =========================================================
   01 HERO
========================================================= */

.bh-hero{
    padding:64px 20px 52px;

    text-align:center;

    background:
    radial-gradient(
        circle at 10% 15%,
        rgba(201,154,69,.18),
        transparent 30%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
        circle at 90% 18%,
        rgba(111,148,178,.20),
        transparent 30%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
        140deg,
        #FFFDF8,
        #F4F8FA
    );
}

.bh-hero-inner{
    max-width:1060px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-badge{
    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:15px;

    padding:8px 16px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    rgba(111,148,178,.12);

    border:
    1px solid rgba(69,106,134,.18);

    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);

    font-size:11px;

    font-weight:900;

    letter-spacing:.7px;
}

.bh-hero h1{
    max-width:960px;

    margin:0 auto;

    font-size:
    clamp(40px,5vw,62px);

    line-height:1.02;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-1.6px;
}

.bh-hero h1 span{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--bh-blue-dark),
        var(--bh-blue),
        var(--bh-gold)
    );

    -webkit-background-clip:text;

    background-clip:text;

    color:transparent;
}

.bh-hero-text{
    max-width:800px;

    margin:
    18px auto 22px;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.65;
}

.bh-hero-highlights{
    display:flex;

    flex-wrap:wrap;

    justify-content:center;

    gap:7px;

    margin-bottom:24px;
}

.bh-hero-highlights span{
    padding:7px 11px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.92);

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);

    font-size:12px;

    font-weight:850;
}

.bh-hero-image{
    max-width:960px;

    margin:0 auto;

    padding:7px;

    border-radius:22px;

    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(111,148,178,.34),
        rgba(201,154,69,.22)
    );

    box-shadow:
    0 23px 56px
    rgba(51,60,65,.13);

    overflow:hidden;
}

.bh-hero-image img{
    border-radius:16px;
}

.bh-trust-strip{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:8px;

    max-width:960px;

    margin:
    14px auto 0;
}

.bh-trust-item{
    padding:
    11px 8px;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.9);

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    color:
    var(--bh-text);

    font-size:12px;

    line-height:1.35;

    font-weight:850;
}


/* =========================================================
   02 CORE BENEFIT GRID 2x2
========================================================= */

.bh-core{
    background:#fff;
}

.bh-core-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:13px;

    max-width:1000px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-core-card{
    min-width:0;

    padding:20px;

    border:

    border-radius:17px;

    box-shadow:
    var(--bh-shadow);
}

.bh-core-card:nth-child(1){
    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);
}

.bh-core-card:nth-child(2){
    background:
    var(--bh-green-light);
}

.bh-core-card:nth-child(3){
    background:
    var(--bh-gold-light);
}

.bh-core-card:nth-child(4){
    background:
    var(--bh-gray-light);
}

.bh-core-icon{
    width:44px;
    height:44px;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:9px;

    border-radius:13px;

    background:#fff;

    font-size:21px;
}

.bh-core-card h3{
    margin:0 0 6px;

    font-size:17px;

    line-height:1.3;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-core-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.52;
}


/* =========================================================
   03 FIVE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.bh-details{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--bh-warm),
        #FFFFFF
    );
}

.bh-feature-list{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:14px;

    max-width:980px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-feature-card{
    min-width:0;

    padding:20px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    border-radius:20px;

    background:#fff;

    box-shadow:
    var(--bh-shadow);
}

.bh-feature-card:first-child{
    grid-column:
    1 / -1;

    padding:22px;
}

.bh-feature-card:nth-child(2){
    background:
    var(--bh-green-light);
}

.bh-feature-card:nth-child(3){
    background:
    var(--bh-gold-light);
}

.bh-feature-card:nth-child(4){
    background:
    var(--bh-gray-light);
}

.bh-feature-card:nth-child(5){
    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);
}

.bh-feature-image{
    margin-bottom:16px;

    overflow:hidden;

    border-radius:15px;

    background:#fff;
}

.bh-feature-image img{
    border-radius:12px;
}

.bh-feature-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 7px;

    font-size:20px;

    line-height:1.28;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-feature-card:first-child h3{
    font-size:24px;
}

.bh-feature-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.56;
}

.bh-points{
    margin:

    padding:0;

    list-style:none;
}

.bh-points li{
    margin-bottom:6px;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   HOW IT WORKS
========================================================= */

.bh-how{
    max-width:980px;

    margin:
    20px auto 0;

    padding:18px;

    border-radius:18px;

    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);

    border:
    1px solid rgba(111,148,178,.18);
}

.bh-how h3{
    margin:
    0 0 14px;

    text-align:center;

    font-size:21px;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-step-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:9px;
}

.bh-step{
    padding:14px;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:#fff;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.52;
}

.bh-step-number{
    width:30px;
    height:30px;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:8px;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:
    var(--bh-gold-light);

    color:
    var(--bh-gold);

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-step strong{
    display:block;

    margin-bottom:4px;

    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);
}


/* =========================================================
   04 SIMPLE TO USE + INFO GRID
========================================================= */

.bh-info{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        #FFFFFF,
        var(--bh-gray-light)
    );
}

.bh-info-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:14px;

    max-width:940px;

    margin:
    0 auto 28px;
}

.bh-info-card{
    min-width:0;

    padding:18px;

    border-radius:16px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px
    rgba(51,60,65,.045);
}

.bh-info-card:nth-child(1){
    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);
}

.bh-info-card:nth-child(2){
    background:
    var(--bh-green-light);
}

.bh-info-card:nth-child(3){
    background:
    var(--bh-gold-light);
}

.bh-info-card:nth-child(4){
    background:
    var(--bh-gray-light);
}

.bh-info-icon{
    width:42px;
    height:42px;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:9px;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:#fff;

    font-size:20px;
}

.bh-info-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 7px;

    font-size:17px;

    line-height:1.3;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-info-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.53;
}


/* =========================================================
   PRODUCT INFORMATION
========================================================= */

.bh-product-info-heading{
    max-width:940px;

    margin:
    0 auto 18px;

    text-align:left;
}

.bh-product-info-heading .bh-eyebrow{
    margin-bottom:8px;
}

.bh-product-info-heading h2{
    margin:
    0 0 8px;

    font-size:30px;

    line-height:1.12;

    font-weight:950;

    letter-spacing:-.6px;
}

.bh-product-info-heading h2 span{
    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);
}

.bh-product-info-heading p{
    max-width:700px;

    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:15px;

    line-height:1.6;
}


/* =========================================================
   SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.bh-spec-box{
    max-width:940px;

    margin:0 auto;

    padding:9px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    border-radius:18px;

    background:#fff;

    box-shadow:
    var(--bh-shadow);
}

.bh-spec-row{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    34% 66%;

    margin-bottom:6px;

    overflow:hidden;

    border-radius:10px;

    border:
    1px solid rgba(111,148,178,.17);
}

.bh-spec-row:last-child{
    margin-bottom:0;
}

.bh-spec-label{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    padding:
    12px 14px;

    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);

    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);

    font-size:13px;

    line-height:1.45;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-spec-value{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    padding:
    12px 14px;

    background:#fff;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:13px;

    line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 FAQ
========================================================= */

.bh-faq{
    background:#fff;
}

.bh-faq-list{
    max-width:920px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-faq details{
    margin-bottom:8px;

    overflow:hidden;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    border-radius:13px;

    background:#fff;

    transition:
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.bh-faq details[open]{
    box-shadow:
    0 8px 24px
    rgba(51,60,65,.06);
}

.bh-faq summary{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;

    gap:14px;

    padding:
    16px 18px;

    cursor:pointer;

    list-style:none;

    color:
    var(--bh-text);

    font-size:15px;

    line-height:1.4;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
    display:none;
}

.bh-faq summary::after{
    content:"⌄";

    width:28px;
    height:28px;

    flex:none;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);

    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);

    transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.bh-faq details[open] summary::after{
    transform:
    rotate(180deg);

    background:
    var(--bh-blue);

    color:#fff;
}

.bh-faq-answer{
    padding:
    0 18px 17px;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.62;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 SOCIAL PROOF + CUSTOMER PHOTOS
========================================================= */

.bh-feedback{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        #FFFDF8,
        var(--bh-blue-light)
    );
}

.bh-recognition{
    max-width:900px;

    margin:
    0 auto 20px;

    padding:17px;

    border-radius:16px;

    text-align:center;

    background:
    var(--bh-gold-light);

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);
}

.bh-recognition strong{
    display:block;

    margin-bottom:4px;

    font-size:19px;

    line-height:1.3;
}

.bh-recognition p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.52;
}

.bh-photo-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:10px;

    max-width:980px;

    margin:
    0 auto 18px;
}

.bh-photo-card{
    padding:7px;

    border-radius:15px;

    background:#fff;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);
}

.bh-photo-card img{
    border-radius:10px;
}

.bh-review-grid{
    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

    gap:10px;

    max-width:980px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-review-card{
    padding:16px;

    border-radius:16px;

    background:#fff;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    box-shadow:
    var(--bh-shadow);
}

.bh-review-label{
    display:inline-flex;

    margin-bottom:8px;

    padding:5px 9px;

    border-radius:999px;

    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);

    color:
    var(--bh-blue-dark);

    font-size:10px;

    font-weight:900;
}

.bh-review-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 6px;

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.3;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-review-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.53;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.bh-guarantees{
    background:
    linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--bh-gray-light),
        #FFFFFF
    );
}

.bh-guarantee-list{
    display:flex;

    flex-direction:column;

    gap:10px;

    max-width:900px;

    margin:0 auto;
}

.bh-guarantee-card{
    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    gap:14px;

    padding:
    16px 18px;

    border:
    1px solid var(--bh-border);

    border-radius:16px;

    background:#fff;

    box-shadow:
    var(--bh-shadow);
}

.bh-guarantee-icon{
    width:46px;
    height:46px;

    flex:none;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    border-radius:13px;

    background:
    var(--bh-blue-light);

    font-size:21px;
}

.bh-guarantee-card h3{
    margin:
    0 0 4px;

    font-size:16px;

    line-height:1.3;

    font-weight:950;
}

.bh-guarantee-card p{
    margin:0;

    color:
    var(--bh-muted);

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CTA
========================================================= */

.bh-cta{
    padding:
    64px 20px;

    text-align:center;

    color:#fff;

    background:
    radial-gradient(

    ),

.bh-cta h2{

.bh-floating-buy:hover{

.cpm-benefits{

  color:var(--brown-dark);
}

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}

/* =========================================================
   10 FAQ
========================================================= */

.cpm-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #faf3eb 0%,
      #f1f5ef 100%
    );
}

.cpm-faq-list{
  max-width:930px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cpm-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #dfd5cb;

  background:#fffdf9;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 10px rgba(74,48,38,.035);
}

.cpm-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cpm-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;

  padding:14px 16px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.cpm-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.cpm-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 27px;

  width:27px;
  height:27px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--red-dark);
  background:var(--red-light);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.cpm-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--red-dark);
}

.cpm-faq-answer{
  padding:0 16px 14px;

  color:#69615c;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.cwl-page,

.cwl-intro-copy{
  max-width:980px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:25px 28px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #fff,
      #f4eee1
    );
}

.cwl-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:28px;
  line-height:1.12;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cwl-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--orange);
}

.cwl-intro-copy p{
  max-width:780px;
  margin:0 auto 16px;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.58;
}

.cwl-mini-points{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px;
}

.cwl-mini-point{
  padding:11px 10px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;
}

.cwl-mini-point strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:2px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:13px;
}

.cwl-mini-point span{
  color:#777;

  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.38;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.cwl-features{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #f0f3f2,
      #fff9ed
    );
}

.cwl-feature-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
}

.cwl-feature{
  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:15px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 16px rgba(45,55,55,.055);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cwl-feature:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px);

  box-shadow:
    0 11px 25px rgba(45,55,55,.10);
}

.cwl-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff;
}

.cwl-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff6d5;
}

.cwl-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf3f5;
}

.cwl-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#edf5ef;
}

.cwl-feature-copy{
  padding:16px 18px;
}

.cwl-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.18;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cwl-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.cwl-benefits{
  background:#fff;
}

.cwl-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1040px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cwl-benefit{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:20px 21px 20px 24px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.cwl-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;
  top:0;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;

  width:4px;

  background:var(--yellow-dark);
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff7d5;
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(2){
  background:#edf3f5;
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(2)::before{
  background:var(--blue);
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf5ef;
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(3)::before{
  background:var(--green);
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff1df;
}

.cwl-benefit:nth-child(4)::before{
  background:var(--orange);
}

.cwl-benefit-num{
  margin-bottom:3px;

  color:var(--orange-dark);

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.cwl-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cwl-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 USE CASES
========================================================= */

.cwl-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #fff0dd,
      #faf8f1
    );
}

.cwl-scene-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1060px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cwl-scene{
  padding:20px 15px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #e6dccd;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(80,70,45,.05);
}

.cwl-scene-icon{
  width:44px;
  height:44px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 8px;

  border-radius:12px;

  color:var(--orange-dark);
  background:var(--orange-light);

  font-size:20px;
}

.cwl-scene:nth-child(2) .cwl-scene-icon{
  color:var(--blue-dark);
  background:var(--blue-light);
}

.cwl-scene:nth-child(3) .cwl-scene-icon{
  color:var(--green-dark);
  background:var(--green-light);
}

.cwl-scene:nth-child(4) .cwl-scene-icon{
  color:#b17b18;
  background:var(--yellow-light);
}

.cwl-scene:nth-child(5) .cwl-scene-icon{
  color:var(--steel);
  background:var(--steel-light);
}

.cwl-scene:nth-child(6) .cwl-scene-icon{
  color:var(--orange-dark);
  background:var(--orange-light);
}

.cwl-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cwl-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.cwl-specs{
  background:#fff;
}

.cwl-spec-box{
  max-width:970px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:8px;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#f7f5f0;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.045);
}

.cwl-spec-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:34% 66%;

  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:5px;

  border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid #dfddd5;

  background:#fff;
}

.cwl-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cwl-spec-label{
  padding:11px 13px;

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--dark);

  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.cwl-spec-value{
  padding:11px 13px;

  color:#656b67;
  background:#fff;

  font-size:13px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

.cwl-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #fff6d8,
      #edf3f5
    );
}

.cwl-review-note{
  max-width:800px;
  margin:-5px auto 20px;
  padding:10px 13px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #e2ddd4;

  color:#756d65;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);

  font-size:11px;
}

.cwl-review-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1060px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cwl-review{
  padding:18px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #e0ddd5;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(70,70,50,.045);
}

.cwl-review:nth-child(2){
  background:#edf3f5;
}

.cwl-review:nth-child(3){
  background:#fff1df;
}

.cwl-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:5px;

  color:#e59b00;

  font-size:13px;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.cwl-review h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cwl-review p{
  margin:0;

  color:#69716f;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}

.cwl-review-user{
  margin-top:8px;

  color:#969a96;

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.4px;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.cwl-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #edf4ef,
      #f8f2e7
    );
}

.cwl-faq-list{
  max-width:930px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cwl-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #dddcd3;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.035);
}

.cwl-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cwl-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;

  padding:14px 16px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.cwl-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.cwl-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 27px;

  width:27px;
  height:27px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--orange-dark);
  background:var(--orange-light);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.cwl-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--orange-dark);
}

.cwl-faq-answer{
  padding:0 16px 14px;

  color:#68706b;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}


/* =========================================================
   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.cwl-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.cwl-guarantee-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1050px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cwl-guarantee{
  padding:18px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
}

.cwl-guarantee:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf3f5;
}

.cwl-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff1df;
}

.cwl-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf5ef;
}

.cwl-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff7d7;
}

.cwl-guarantee-icon{
  width:39px;
  height:39px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:7px;

  border-radius:10px;

  color:var(--black);
  background:#fff;

  font-size:19px;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.055);
}

.cwl-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cwl-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:#68716c;

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   11 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.cwl-cta{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:55px 20px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 20%,
      rgba(255,210,28,.25),
      transparent 25%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(242,138,36,.22),
      transparent 27%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #1b2225,
      #303b3f,
      #5a402d
    );
}

.cwl-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:39px;
  line-height:1.08;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.cwl-cta h2 span{
  color:var(--yellow);
}

.cwl-cta p{
  max-width:680px;
  margin:0 auto 20px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.cwl-btn{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:49px;
  padding:0 27px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#1d2428;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ffdc3a,
      #f4b900
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 9px 23px rgba(0,0,0,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cwl-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 15px 31px rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}

.cwl-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOATING BUY NOW
========================================================= */

.cwl-floating-buy{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:99999;

  right:16px;
  bottom:16px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:48px;
  padding:0 20px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#1d2428;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ffdc3a,
      #f4b900
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cwl-floating-buy:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.03);

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 33px rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}

.cwl-floating-buy:active{
  transform:scale(.90);
}

  margin:0 0 10px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:39px;
  line-height:1.08;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.mfs-title span{
  color:var(--red);
}

.mfs-description{
  max-width:720px;
  margin:0 auto;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.55;
}


/* =========================================================
   IMAGE
========================================================= */

.mfs-image{
  width:100%;
  margin:0;
  padding:0;

  line-height:0;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.mfs-image img{
  width:100%;
  height:auto;
  object-fit:contain;
}


/* =========================================================
   01 HERO
========================================================= */

.mfs-hero{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:54px 20px 56px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 10%,
      rgba(228,81,69,.28),
      transparent 28%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 92% 90%,
      rgba(111,155,69,.25),
      transparent 30%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #202a25 0%,
      #2f4033 56%,
      #3f5137 100%
    );
}

.mfs-hero-copy{
  max-width:880px;
  margin:0 auto 25px;
  text-align:center;
}

.mfs-badge{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:12px;
  padding:6px 13px;

  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);

  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.mfs-hero h1{
  margin:0 0 13px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:52px;
  line-height:1.02;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1.7px;
}

.mfs-hero h1 span{
  color:#ff8276;
}

.mfs-hero-text{
  max-width:740px;
  margin:0 auto 17px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);

  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.mfs-pills{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:6px;
}

.mfs-pills span{
  padding:6px 10px;

  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);

  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:850;
}

.mfs-hero-image{
  max-width:1080px;
  margin:0 auto;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:20px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}


/* =========================================================
   02 GIF / DEMONSTRATION
========================================================= */

.mfs-demo{
  padding:50px 20px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #344b32,
      #29382f 58%,
      #703b35
    );
}

.mfs-demo .mfs-eyebrow{
  color:#dff1c9;
  background:rgba(180,220,130,.11);
  border:1px solid rgba(180,220,130,.18);
}

.mfs-demo .mfs-title{
  color:#fff;
}

.mfs-demo .mfs-title span{
  color:#ff8778;
}

.mfs-demo .mfs-description{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.74);
}

.mfs-demo-box{
  max-width:980px;
  margin:0 auto;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
}


/* =========================================================
   03 PRODUCT INTRODUCTION
========================================================= */

.mfs-intro{
  background:var(--cream);
}

.mfs-intro-image{
  max-width:1050px;
  margin:0 auto 20px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 8px 22px rgba(60,70,50,.06);
}

.mfs-intro-copy{
  max-width:980px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:25px 28px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #fff,
      #f5eddf
    );
}

.mfs-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:28px;
  line-height:1.12;
  font-weight:950;
}

.mfs-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--red);
}

.mfs-intro-copy p{
  max-width:780px;
  margin:0 auto 16px;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.58;
}

.mfs-mini-points{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px;
}

.mfs-mini-point{
  padding:11px 10px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;
}

.mfs-mini-point strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:2px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:13px;
}

.mfs-mini-point span{
  color:#777;

  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.38;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.mfs-features{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #edf4e7,
      #fffaf2
    );
}

.mfs-feature-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
}

.mfs-feature{
  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:15px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 16px rgba(55,75,45,.055);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.mfs-feature:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px);

  box-shadow:
    0 11px 25px rgba(55,75,45,.10);
}

.mfs-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff;
}

.mfs-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff0ed;
}

.mfs-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2f3;
}

.mfs-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#edf5e8;
}

.mfs-feature-copy{
  padding:16px 18px;
}

.mfs-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.18;
  font-weight:950;
}

.mfs-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.mfs-benefits{
  background:#fff;
}

.mfs-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1040px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.mfs-benefit{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:20px 21px 20px 24px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.mfs-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;
  top:0;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;

  width:4px;

  background:var(--red);
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff0ed;
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(2){
  background:#edf5e8;
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(2)::before{
  background:var(--green);
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2f3;
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(3)::before{
  background:var(--steel);
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff3e3;
}

.mfs-benefit:nth-child(4)::before{
  background:var(--orange);
}

.mfs-benefit-num{
  margin-bottom:3px;

  color:var(--red-dark);

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.mfs-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:950;
}

.mfs-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 USE CASES
========================================================= */

.mfs-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #fff1df,
      #fffaf2
    );
}

.mfs-scene-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1060px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.mfs-scene{
  padding:20px 15px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #e6dccd;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(80,70,45,.05);
}

.mfs-scene-icon{
  width:44px;
  height:44px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 8px;

  border-radius:12px;

  color:var(--red-dark);
  background:var(--red-light);

  font-size:20px;
}

.mfs-scene:nth-child(2) .mfs-scene-icon{
  color:var(--green-dark);
  background:var(--green-light);
}

.mfs-scene:nth-child(3) .mfs-scene-icon{
  color:#c47330;
  background:var(--orange-light);
}

.mfs-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.mfs-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.mfs-specs{
  background:#fff;
}

.mfs-spec-box{
  max-width:970px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:8px;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#f7f5f0;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.045);
}

.mfs-spec-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:34% 66%;

  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:5px;

  border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid #dfddd5;

  background:#fff;
}

.mfs-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.mfs-spec-label{
  padding:11px 13px;

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--dark);

  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.mfs-spec-value{
  padding:11px 13px;

  color:#656b67;
  background:#fff;

  font-size:13px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

.mfs-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #fff0ed,
      #f0f5e9
    );
}

.mfs-review-note{
  max-width:800px;
  margin:-5px auto 20px;
  padding:10px 13px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #e5ddd4;

  color:#756d65;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);

  font-size:11px;
}

.mfs-review-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1060px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.mfs-review{
  padding:18px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #e2ddd5;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(70,70,50,.045);
}

.mfs-review:nth-child(2){
  background:#edf4e8;
}

.mfs-review:nth-child(3){
  background:#fff4e5;
}

.mfs-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:5px;

  color:#e15b42;

  font-size:13px;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.mfs-review h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.mfs-review p{
  margin:0;

  color:#69716c;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}

.mfs-review-user{
  margin-top:8px;

  color:#969a96;

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.4px;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.mfs-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #edf4e8,
      #f7f2e9
    );
}

.mfs-faq-list{
  max-width:930px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.mfs-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #dddcd3;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.035);
}

.mfs-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.mfs-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;

  padding:14px 16px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.mfs-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.mfs-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 27px;

  width:27px;
  height:27px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--red-dark);
  background:var(--red-light);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.mfs-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--red-dark);
}

.mfs-faq-answer{
  padding:0 16px 14px;

  color:#68706b;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}


/* =========================================================
   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.mfs-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.mfs-guarantee-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1050px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.mfs-guarantee{
  padding:18px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
}

.mfs-guarantee:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf2f3;
}

.mfs-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff0ed;
}

.mfs-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf5e8;
}

.mfs-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff3e4;
}

.mfs-guarantee-icon{
  width:39px;
  height:39px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:7px;

  border-radius:10px;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:19px;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.055);
}

.mfs-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.mfs-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:#68716c;

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   11 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.mfs-cta{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:55px 20px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 20%,
      rgba(228,81,69,.30),
      transparent 25%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(111,155,69,.23),
      transparent 27%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #202923,
      #31402f,
      #49352f
    );
}

.mfs-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:39px;
  line-height:1.08;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.mfs-cta h2 span{
  color:#ff8578;
}

.mfs-cta p{
  max-width:680px;
  margin:0 auto 20px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.mfs-btn{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:49px;
  padding:0 27px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #e45b4d,
      #c43e36
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 9px 23px rgba(0,0,0,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.mfs-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 15px 31px rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}

.mfs-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOATING BUY NOW
========================================================= */

.mfs-floating-buy{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:99999;

  right:16px;
  bottom:16px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:48px;
  padding:0 20px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #e45b4d,
      #c43e36
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.mfs-floating-buy:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.03);

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 33px rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}

.mfs-floating-buy:active{
  transform:scale(.90);
}

}

}

/* =========================================================
   03 PRODUCT INTRODUCTION
========================================================= */

.nlr-intro{
  background:var(--cream);
}

.nlr-intro-image{
  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto 22px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:20px;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 25px rgba(80,55,35,.07);
}

.nlr-intro-copy{
  max-width:1000px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:27px 30px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:19px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #fff,
      #f4eadf
    );
}

.nlr-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 10px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:28px;
  line-height:1.15;
  font-weight:950;
}

.nlr-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--red);
}

.nlr-intro-copy p{
  max-width:800px;
  margin:0 auto 17px;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.58;
}

.nlr-mini-points{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));

}

.nlr-mini-point{

.nlr-mini-point strong{

  font-size:13px;
}

.nlr-mini-point span{
  color:#777;

  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.35;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.nlr-features{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #f0e8df,
      #fbf7f0
    );
}

.nlr-feature-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:11px;
}

.nlr-feature{
  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 17px rgba(70,50,35,.06);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.nlr-feature:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 26px rgba(70,50,35,.12);
}

.nlr-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff;
}

.nlr-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff0eb;
}

.nlr-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf1f2;
}

.nlr-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#f1eee8;
}

.nlr-feature-copy{
  padding:17px 19px;
}

.nlr-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:19px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:950;
}

.nlr-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.nlr-benefits{
  background:#fff;
}

.nlr-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1080px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.nlr-benefit{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:20px 21px 20px 24px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.nlr-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;
  top:0;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;

  width:4px;

  background:var(--red);
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff0eb;
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(2){
  background:#f1eee9;
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(2)::before{
  background:var(--orange);
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf1f2;
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(3)::before{
  background:var(--steel);
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(4){
  background:#eef2eb;
}

.nlr-benefit:nth-child(4)::before{
  background:var(--green);
}

.nlr-benefit-num{
  margin-bottom:4px;

  color:var(--red-dark);

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:1.1px;
}

.nlr-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:19px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:950;
}

.nlr-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 USE CASES
========================================================= */

.nlr-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #f5e8db,
      #fbf7f0
    );
}

.nlr-scene-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.nlr-scene{
  padding:19px 17px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:15px;
  border:1px solid #e4d8cb;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 17px rgba(80,55,35,.055);
}

.nlr-scene-icon{
  width:44px;
  height:44px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 8px;

  border-radius:12px;

  color:var(--red-dark);
  background:var(--red-light);

  font-size:20px;
}

.nlr-scene:nth-child(2) .nlr-scene-icon{
  color:#b96832;
  background:#fff0df;
}

.nlr-scene:nth-child(3) .nlr-scene-icon{
  color:#68785f;
  background:#edf2ea;
}

.nlr-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.nlr-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.nlr-specs{
  background:#fff;
}

.nlr-spec-box{
  max-width:1000px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:8px;

  border-radius:17px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#f8f6f2;

  box-shadow:
    0 8px 21px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}

.nlr-spec-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:36% 64%;

  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:5px;

  border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid #dfd9d1;

  background:#fff;
}

.nlr-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.nlr-spec-label{
  padding:11px 14px;

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--dark);

  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.nlr-spec-value{
  padding:11px 14px;

  color:#65615d;
  background:#fff;

  font-size:13px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

.nlr-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #fff2eb,
      #f3eae0
    );
}

.nlr-review-note{
  max-width:800px;
  margin:-4px auto 20px;
  padding:10px 14px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #eadbd1;

  color:#756d65;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);

  font-size:11px;
}

.nlr-review-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.nlr-review{
  padding:17px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #e5ddd4;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 17px rgba(80,55,35,.05);
}

.nlr-review:nth-child(2){
  background:#f1f4f4;
}

.nlr-review:nth-child(3){
  background:#f0f3ed;
}

.nlr-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:6px;

  color:#d56a45;

  font-size:13px;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.nlr-review h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.nlr-review p{
  margin:0;

  color:#69716f;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}

.nlr-review-user{
  margin-top:8px;

  color:#959995;

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.4px;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.nlr-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #eee8df,
      #f4f2ed
    );
}

.nlr-faq-list{
  max-width:950px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.nlr-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:11px;
  border:1px solid #ded8d0;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 11px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
}

.nlr-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.nlr-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:13px;

  padding:14px 17px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.nlr-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.nlr-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 27px;

  width:27px;
  height:27px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--red-dark);
  background:var(--red-light);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.nlr-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--red-dark);
}

.nlr-faq-answer{
  padding:0 17px 14px;

  color:#68706e;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.nlr-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.nlr-guarantee-grid{

  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

}

.nlr-guarantee{

}

  background:#f0f3f3;
}

.nlr-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff0eb;
}

.nlr-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2ea;
}

.nlr-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#f4eee7;
}

.nlr-guarantee-icon{
  width:39px;

  display:flex;

  margin-bottom:7px;

  border-radius:10px;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:19px;

  box-shadow:

}

.nlr-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.nlr-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:#68716e;

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}

   11 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.nlr-cta{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:58px 24px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 20%,
      rgba(201,79,61,.30),
      transparent 25%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(217,130,69,.16),
      transparent 27%

    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #272421,
      #3a322d,
      #51352f
    );
}

.nlr-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:39px;
  line-height:1.08;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

  color:#f28b72;
}

.nlr-cta p{
  max-width:700px;
  margin:0 auto 20px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.nlr-btn{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:50px;
  padding:0 28px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #d9684f,
      #ad3e31
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 9px 23px rgba(0,0,0,.30);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.nlr-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 15px 31px rgba(0,0,0,.38);
}

.nlr-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}

    );
