  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}


/* =========================================================
   02 GIF / DEMONSTRATION
========================================================= */

.cst-demo{
  padding:68px 24px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #394044,
      #202426 62%,
      #51301f
    );
}

.cst-demo .cst-eyebrow{
  color:#ffc4a1;
  background:rgba(229,111,47,.13);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,160,110,.18);
}

.cst-demo .cst-title{
  color:#fff;
}

.cst-demo .cst-title span{
  color:#ff9b62;
}

.cst-demo .cst-description{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
}

.cst-demo-box{
  max-width:1050px;
  margin:0 auto;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:22px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}


/* =========================================================
   03 PRODUCT INTRODUCTION
========================================================= */

.cst-intro{
  background:var(--cream);
}

.cst-intro-image{
  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto 30px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:22px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}

.cst-intro-copy{
  max-width:1000px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:34px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:22px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #ffffff,
      #eeeae2
    );
}

.cst-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 14px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:30px;
  line-height:1.15;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cst-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--orange);
}

.cst-intro-copy p{
  max-width:820px;
  margin:0 auto 22px;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.63;
}

.cst-mini-points{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:8px;
}

.cst-mini-point{
  padding:14px 12px;

  border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;
}

.cst-mini-point strong{
  display:block;

  margin-bottom:3px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:14px;
}

.cst-mini-point span{
  color:#777;

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.4;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.cst-features{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #e9edef,
      #f7f4ee
    );
}

.cst-feature-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:15px;
}

.cst-feature{
  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cst-feature:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);

  box-shadow:
    0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}

.cst-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff;
}

.cst-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff0e7;
}

.cst-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2f3;
}

.cst-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#edf2ed;
}

.cst-feature-copy{
  padding:21px;
}

.cst-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cst-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.55;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.cst-benefits{
  background:#fff;
}

.cst-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;

  max-width:1080px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cst-benefit{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:25px 25px 25px 28px;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.cst-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;
  top:0;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;

  width:4px;

  background:var(--orange);
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff2ea;
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(2){
  background:#edf2f3;
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(2)::before{
  background:var(--steel-dark);
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2ed;
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(3)::before{
  background:var(--green);
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(4){
  background:#f0eee9;
}

.cst-benefit:nth-child(4)::before{
  background:#806c58;
}

.cst-benefit-num{
  margin-bottom:5px;

  color:var(--orange-dark);

  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:1.2px;
}

.cst-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 6px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.25;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cst-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.52;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 APPLICATION SCENES
========================================================= */

.cst-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #edf2f3,
      #f7f4ee
    );
}

.cst-scene-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;

  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cst-scene{
  padding:25px 20px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:17px;
  border:1px solid #dfe3e2;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(50,60,60,.055);
}

.cst-scene-icon{
  width:49px;
  height:49px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 11px;

  border-radius:14px;

  color:var(--orange-dark);
  background:var(--orange-light);

  font-size:22px;
}

.cst-scene:nth-child(2) .cst-scene-icon{
  color:var(--steel-dark);
  background:var(--steel-light);
}

.cst-scene:nth-child(3) .cst-scene-icon{
  color:var(--green);
  background:var(--green-light);
}

.cst-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cst-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.cst-specs{
  background:#fff;
}

.cst-spec-box{
  max-width:1000px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:10px;

  border-radius:19px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#f5f5f2;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}

.cst-spec-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:36% 64%;

  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:9px;
  border:1px solid #dedbd4;

  background:#fff;
}

.cst-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cst-spec-label{
  padding:13px 15px;

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--black);

  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.cst-spec-value{
  padding:13px 15px;

  color:#65696a;
  background:#fff;

  font-size:14px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

.cst-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #fff2e9,
      #edf2f3
    );
}

.cst-review-note{
  max-width:800px;
  margin:-12px auto 27px;
  padding:12px 15px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:11px;
  border:1px solid #e1ddd5;

  color:#756d65;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);

  font-size:12px;
}

.cst-review-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;

  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cst-review{
  padding:21px;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid #e2ded7;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}

.cst-review:nth-child(2){
  background:#eef3f4;
}

.cst-review:nth-child(3){
  background:#eef3ed;
}

.cst-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:8px;

  color:#df7130;

  font-size:14px;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.cst-review h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cst-review p{
  margin:0;

  color:#69706f;

  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.52;
}

.cst-review-user{
  margin-top:11px;

  color:#959995;

  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.4px;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.cst-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #e9edef,
      #f1eee8
    );
}

.cst-faq-list{
  max-width:950px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cst-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:8px;

  border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid #d8dcd9;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 4px 13px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
}

.cst-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cst-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:15px;

  padding:16px 18px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.cst-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.cst-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 29px;

  width:29px;
  height:29px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--orange-dark);
  background:var(--orange-light);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.cst-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--orange-dark);
}

.cst-faq-answer{
  padding:0 18px 17px;

  color:#68706f;

  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.6;
}


/* =========================================================
   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.cst-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.cst-guarantee-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;

  max-width:1080px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cst-guarantee{
  padding:22px;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.045);
}

.cst-guarantee:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf2f3;
}

.cst-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#fff1e8;
}

.cst-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2ed;
}

.cst-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#f1eee8;
}

.cst-guarantee-icon{
  width:43px;
  height:43px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:9px;

  border-radius:11px;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:21px;

  box-shadow:
    0 4px 11px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}

.cst-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.cst-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:#68716e;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   11 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.cst-cta{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:72px 24px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 20%,
      rgba(229,111,47,.28),
      transparent 25%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(113,128,135,.18),
      transparent 27%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #17191a,
      #272b2d,
      #34393b
    );
}

.cst-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 12px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:42px;
  line-height:1.1;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1.2px;
}

.cst-cta h2 span{
  color:#ff9b60;
}

.cst-cta p{
  max-width:720px;
  margin:0 auto 26px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);

  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.58;
}

.cst-btn{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:53px;
  padding:0 30px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ed8443,
      #c9561d
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.3);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cst-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 17px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.38);
}

.cst-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOATING BUY NOW
========================================================= */

.cst-floating-buy{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:99999;

  right:17px;
  bottom:17px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:50px;
  padding:0 21px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ed8443,
      #c9561d
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 11px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.3);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cst-floating-buy:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.03);

  box-shadow:
    0 17px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.38);
}

.cst-floating-buy:active{
  transform:scale(.9);
}

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #173e54,
      #28607c 62%,
      #4b8fa0
    );
}

.tw-demo .tw-eyebrow{
  color:#fff;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}

.tw-demo .tw-title{
  color:#fff;
}

.tw-demo .tw-title span{
  color:#bfe9f2;
}

.tw-demo .tw-description{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);
}

.tw-demo-box{
  max-width:1050px;

  margin:0 auto;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:22px;

  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.23);
}


/* =========================================================
   03 PRODUCT INTRODUCTION
========================================================= */

.tw-intro{
  background:var(--cream);
}

.tw-intro-image{
  max-width:1100px;

  margin:0 auto 30px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:22px;

  background:#fff;

  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 30px rgba(21,82,116,.07);
}

.tw-intro-copy{
  max-width:1000px;

  margin:0 auto;

  padding:34px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:22px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #fff,
      #edf7fa
    );

  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.tw-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 14px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:30px;
  line-height:1.15;

  font-weight:950;
}

.tw-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--blue);
}

.tw-intro-copy p{
  max-width:790px;

  margin:0 auto 21px;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.62;
}

.tw-mini-points{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:8px;
}

.tw-mini-point{
  padding:13px;

  border-radius:12px;

  background:#fff;

  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.tw-mini-point strong{
  display:block;

  margin-bottom:2px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:14px;
}

.tw-mini-point span{
  color:#758187;

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.4;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.tw-features{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #edf7fa,
      #f7faf8
    );
}

.tw-feature-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:15px;
}

.tw-feature{
  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:18px;

  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(21,82,116,.05);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.tw-feature:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);

  box-shadow:
    0 13px 30px rgba(21,82,116,.11);
}

.tw-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff;
}

.tw-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#edf8fb;
}

.tw-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#eef6f0;
}

.tw-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#f2eff8;
}

.tw-feature-copy{
  padding:21px;
}

.tw-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.2;

  font-weight:950;
}

.tw-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.55;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.tw-benefits{
  background:#fff;
}

.tw-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:12px;

  max-width:1080px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.tw-benefit{
  position:relative;

  overflow:hidden;

  padding:24px 25px;

  border-radius:16px;

  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.tw-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;

  top:0;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;

  width:4px;

  background:var(--blue);
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf7fa;
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(2){
  background:#eef6f0;
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(2)::before{
  background:var(--green);
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(3){
  background:#f3eff8;
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(3)::before{
  background:var(--purple);
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff3ed;
}

.tw-benefit:nth-child(4)::before{
  background:var(--orange);
}

.tw-benefit-num{
  margin-bottom:5px;

  color:var(--blue);

  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:950;

  letter-spacing:1.2px;
}

.tw-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 6px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.25;

  font-weight:950;
}

.tw-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 DAILY USE
========================================================= */

.tw-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #eef6f5,
      #faf8f3
    );
}

.tw-scene-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:12px;

  max-width:1100px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.tw-scene{
  padding:25px 21px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:17px;

  border:1px solid #dfe8e6;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(35,70,70,.05);
}

.tw-scene-icon{
  width:48px;
  height:48px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 11px;

  border-radius:14px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  background:var(--blue-light);

  font-size:22px;
}

.tw-scene:nth-child(2) .tw-scene-icon{
  background:#eaf5ee;
}

.tw-scene:nth-child(3) .tw-scene-icon{
  background:#f0edf7;
}

.tw-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:18px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.tw-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;

  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.tw-specs{
  background:#fff;
}

.tw-spec-box{
  max-width:1000px;

  margin:0 auto;

  padding:10px;

  border-radius:19px;

  background:#f7fafb;

  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 25px rgba(21,82,116,.05);
}

.tw-spec-row{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    36% 64%;

  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:9px;

  border:1px solid #dfe7ea;

  background:#fff;
}

.tw-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.tw-spec-label{
  padding:13px 15px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  background:#e7f2f6;

  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.tw-spec-value{
  padding:13px 15px;

  color:#647279;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:14px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER REVIEWS
========================================================= */

.tw-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #f3f8f6,
      #edf5f7
    );
}

.tw-review-note{
  max-width:760px;

  margin:-12px auto 27px;

  padding:12px 15px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:11px;

  color:#687570;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);

  border:1px solid #dfe9e5;

  font-size:12px;
}

.tw-review-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:12px;

  max-width:1100px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.tw-review{
  padding:21px;

  border-radius:16px;

  background:#fff;

  border:1px solid #dce7e3;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(35,70,70,.05);
}

.tw-review:nth-child(2){
  background:#eef7f3;
}

.tw-review:nth-child(3){
  background:#f3eff8;
}

.tw-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:8px;

  color:#e19a64;

  font-size:14px;

  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.tw-review h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:17px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.tw-review p{
  margin:0;

  color:#69767c;

  font-size:14px;

  line-height:1.52;
}

.tw-review-user{
  margin-top:11px;

  color:#939c9f;

  font-size:10px;

  font-weight:800;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.tw-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #eaf5f8,
      #f2eff7
    );
}

.tw-faq-list{
  max-width:950px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.tw-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:8px;

  border-radius:12px;

  background:#fff;

  border:1px solid #dbe3e6;

  box-shadow:
    0 4px 13px rgba(21,82,116,.04);
}

.tw-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.tw-faq summary{
  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;

  gap:15px;

  padding:16px 18px;

  cursor:pointer;

  list-style:none;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:16px;

  font-weight:900;
}

.tw-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.tw-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 29px;

  width:29px;
  height:29px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  background:#e6f1f5;

  font-size:17px;

  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.tw-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;

  background:var(--blue-dark);
}

.tw-faq-answer{
  padding:0 18px 17px;

  color:#68757b;

  font-size:14px;

  line-height:1.6;
}


/* =========================================================
   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.tw-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.tw-guarantee-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:12px;

  max-width:1080px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.tw-guarantee{
  padding:22px;

  border-radius:16px;

  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 18px rgba(21,82,116,.045);
}

.tw-guarantee:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf5f7;
}

.tw-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#eef6f0;
}

.tw-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#fff4ec;
}

.tw-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#f1edf6;
}

.tw-guarantee-icon{
  width:43px;
  height:43px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:9px;

  border-radius:11px;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:21px;

  box-shadow:
    0 4px 11px rgba(21,82,116,.06);
}

.tw-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:18px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.tw-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:#68757b;

  font-size:13px;

  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   11 CTA
========================================================= */

.tw-cta{
  position:relative;

  overflow:hidden;

  padding:72px 24px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 20%,
      rgba(255,255,255,.14),
      transparent 25%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(88,174,201,.25),
      transparent 28%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #153d53,
      #1f5c76,
      #2e7487
    );
}

.tw-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 12px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:41px;

  line-height:1.1;

  font-weight:950;

  letter-spacing:-1.2px;
}

.tw-cta h2 span{
  color:#bfeaf1;
}

.tw-cta p{
  max-width:700px;

  margin:0 auto 26px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.79);

  font-size:17px;

  line-height:1.58;
}

.tw-btn{
  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;

  justify-content:center;

  min-height:53px;

  padding:0 29px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #5bb6d0,
      #368bab
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:16px;

  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.22);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.tw-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 33px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}

.tw-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOATING BUY NOW
========================================================= */

.tw-floating-buy{
  position:fixed;

  z-index:99999;

  right:17px;

  bottom:17px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;

  justify-content:center;

  min-height:50px;

  padding:0 21px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #5bb6d0,
      #368bab
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:15px;

  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 11px 28px rgba(21,55,65,.3);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.tw-floating-buy:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.03);

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 35px rgba(21,55,65,.38);
}

.tw-floating-buy:active{
  transform:scale(.9);
}

products.body_html:
<style>

   STAINLESS STEEL BURGER PRESS

   RESPONSIVE + MOBILE OPTIMIZED
========================================================= */

.burger-press-page,
.burger-press-page *{

}

  margin:0 auto;

  color:var(--text);

  background:var(--cream);

  font-family:

    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    Helvetica,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;

  line-height:1.6;
}

.burger-press-page img{

  width:100%;
  height:auto;

  margin:0;
  padding:0;

}

========================================================= */

  margin:0 auto;
}

.bp-section{

}

  margin:0 auto 40px;

}

  background:var(--orange-light);

  font-weight:950;

}

.bp-title{

  font-size:41px;

  line-height:1.08;

  font-weight:950;

}

.bp-title span{

}

.bp-description{

  margin:0 auto;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:17px;

  line-height:1.62;
}


/* =========================================================
   IMAGE
========================================================= */

.bp-image{

  margin:0;
  padding:0;

  overflow:hidden;

  line-height:0;

  background:transparent;
}

.bp-image img{

  width:100%;

  margin:0;
  padding:0;

}


/* =========================================================
   01 HERO

========================================================= */

      circle at 5% 10%,

      transparent 27%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 92% 80%,
      rgba(217,109,50,.25),
      transparent 30%

      135deg,
      #111413 0%,
      #252b27 55%,

.bp-hero-grid{

.bp-feature:nth-child(2){

.bp-feature:nth-child(3){

products.title: 360° HD Car Rearview Mirror With Blind Spot Assist And Adjustable Small Round Mirror
products.body_html:
<style>
/* =========================================================
   2PCS 360° ADJUSTABLE CAR BLIND SPOT MIRROR
   SHOPIFY PRODUCT DETAIL PAGE
   US MARKET / CLEAN AUTOMOTIVE STYLE
   RESPONSIVE DESKTOP + MOBILE
   ========================================================= */

.car-mirror-page,
.car-mirror-page *{
  box-sizing:border-box;
}

.car-mirror-page{
  --cm-blue:#1769aa;
  --cm-blue-dark:#0e4f83;
  --cm-blue-light:#eaf5ff;
  --cm-blue-soft:#dceeff;

  --cm-navy:#101c2b;
  --cm-navy-2:#17283b;
  --cm-navy-3:#22384e;

  --cm-white:#ffffff;
  --cm-bg:#f5f8fb;
  --cm-bg-2:#edf3f8;

  --cm-text:#202a34;
  --cm-muted:#65717d;

  --cm-border:#d8e0e7;

  width:100%;
  max-width:1440px;
  margin:0 auto;

  overflow:hidden;

  background:#fff;
  color:var(--cm-text);

  font-family:
    -apple-system,
    BlinkMacSystemFont,
    "Segoe UI",
    Roboto,
    Helvetica,
    Arial,
    sans-serif;

  line-height:1.55;
}

.car-mirror-page img{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  max-width:100%;
  height:auto;
}

.car-mirror-page a{
  text-decoration:none;
}

.cm-container{
  width:100%;
  max-width:1160px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-section{
  padding:64px 22px;
}


/* =========================================================
   GLOBAL HEADING
========================================================= */

.cm-heading{
  max-width:850px;
  margin:0 auto 36px;
  text-align:center;
}

.cm-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;

  margin-bottom:10px;

  color:var(--cm-blue);

  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;

  letter-spacing:1.7px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}

.cm-title{
  margin:0 0 13px;

  color:var(--cm-text);

  font-size:36px;
  line-height:1.08;

  font-weight:950;

  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.cm-title span{
  color:var(--cm-blue);
}

.cm-description{
  max-width:760px;
  margin:0 auto;

  color:var(--cm-muted);

  font-size:20px;
  line-height:1.65;
}


/* =========================================================
   BUTTON
========================================================= */

.cm-btn{
  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:52px;

  padding:0 30px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #2786cf,
      #0f5c99
    );

  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:900;

  letter-spacing:.2px;

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 28px rgba(15,92,153,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cm-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 17px 35px rgba(15,92,153,.38);
}

.cm-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   IMAGE BOX
========================================================= */

.cm-image-box{
  width:100%;
  max-width:1000px;

  margin:0 auto;

  padding:7px;

  border-radius:22px;

  background:#fff;

  border:1px solid var(--cm-border);

  box-shadow:
    0 14px 38px rgba(25,48,68,.09);

  overflow:hidden;
}

.cm-image-box img{
  border-radius:15px;

  object-fit:contain;
}


/* =========================================================
   01 HERO
========================================================= */

.cm-hero{
  position:relative;

  padding:66px 22px 58px;

  color:#fff;

  text-align:center;

  background:

    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 15%,
      rgba(39,134,207,.28),
      transparent 29%
    ),

    radial-gradient(
      circle at 92% 18%,
      rgba(255,255,255,.08),
      transparent 30%
    ),

    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0d1927,
      #1c3044 58%,
      #0b1622
    );
}

.cm-hero-copy{
  max-width:930px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-badge{
  display:inline-flex;

  align-items:center;

  margin-bottom:18px;

  padding:9px 16px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#d9efff;

  background:
    rgba(39,134,207,.16);

  border:
    1px solid rgba(102,183,239,.36);

  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;

  letter-spacing:1.1px;
}

.cm-hero h1{
  margin:0 auto;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:
    clamp(38px,5vw,60px);

  line-height:1.03;

  font-weight:950;

  letter-spacing:-1.8px;
}

.cm-hero h1 span{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      #9edaff,
      #3d9be0,
      #c5e9ff
    );

  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;

  color:transparent;
}

.cm-hero-text{
  max-width:790px;

  margin:19px auto 25px;

  color:
    rgba(255,255,255,.78);

  font-size:20px;

  line-height:1.65;
}

.cm-hero-highlights{
  display:flex;

  flex-wrap:wrap;

  justify-content:center;

  gap:8px;

  margin-bottom:30px;
}

.cm-hero-highlights span{
  padding:8px 13px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#edf8ff;

  background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.07);

  border:
    1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);

  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:850;
}

.cm-hero-image{
  width:100%;
  max-width:1000px;

  margin:0 auto;

  padding:7px;

  border-radius:24px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      rgba(65,155,218,.48),
      rgba(30,80,120,.28)
    );

  box-shadow:
    0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.42);

  overflow:hidden;
}

.cm-hero-image img{
  border-radius:17px;

  background:#f4f7fa;
}


/* =========================================================
   02 GIF / DEMONSTRATION
========================================================= */

.cm-demo{
  padding:48px 22px 66px;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #1b2c3e,
      #243b51
    );
}

.cm-dark-heading .cm-eyebrow{
  color:#79c5f5;
}

.cm-dark-heading .cm-title{
  color:#fff;
}

.cm-dark-heading .cm-description{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
}

.cm-demo .cm-image-box{
  background:#132333;

  border:
    1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);

  box-shadow:
    0 20px 52px rgba(0,0,0,.34);
}


/* =========================================================
   03 PRODUCT INTRO
========================================================= */

.cm-intro{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #f7fbff,
      #edf5fb
    );
}

.cm-intro-image{
  width:100%;
  max-width:1040px;

  margin:0 auto 28px;

  padding:7px;

  border-radius:24px;

  background:#fff;

  border:
    1px solid #d9e4ed;

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 42px rgba(34,62,84,.09);

  overflow:hidden;
}

.cm-intro-image img{
  border-radius:16px;

  object-fit:contain;
}

.cm-intro-copy{
  max-width:920px;

  margin:0 auto;

  padding:30px 32px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:21px;

  background:#fff;

  border:
    1px solid var(--cm-border);

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 32px rgba(30,55,75,.065);
}

.cm-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 12px;

  font-size:29px;
  line-height:1.12;

  font-weight:950;

  letter-spacing:-.7px;
}

.cm-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--cm-blue);
}

.cm-intro-copy p{
  max-width:780px;

  margin:0 auto;

  color:var(--cm-muted);

  font-size:19px;

  line-height:1.65;
}

.cm-intro-list{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:9px;

  margin-top:22px;
}

.cm-intro-list div{
  padding:13px 10px;

  border-radius:11px;

  background:#f0f6fb;

  color:#5f6c77;

  font-size:15px;

  font-weight:800;
}

.cm-intro-list strong{
  display:block;

  margin-bottom:2px;

  color:var(--cm-blue);

  font-size:18px;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.cm-features{
  background:#fff;
}

.cm-feature-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:17px;

  max-width:1120px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-feature{
  min-width:0;

  padding:18px;

  border-radius:18px;

  border:1px solid var(--cm-border);

  overflow:hidden;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 22px rgba(30,45,60,.05);
}

.cm-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf7ff;
}

.cm-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#f5f8fb;
}

.cm-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#f0f5f8;
}

.cm-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#eef7ff;
}

.cm-feature-image{
  width:100%;

  min-height:220px;

  margin-bottom:15px;

  padding:5px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:13px;

  background:#fff;

  border:
    1px solid rgba(40,70,95,.08);

  overflow:hidden;
}

.cm-feature-image img{
  max-height:350px;

  object-fit:contain;

  border-radius:9px;
}

.cm-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 6px;

  font-size:21px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.cm-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--cm-muted);

  font-size:18px;

  line-height:1.58;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE BENEFITS
========================================================= */

.cm-benefits{
  color:#fff;

  background:

    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 12%,
      rgba(44,143,214,.24),
      transparent 29%
    ),

    radial-gradient(
      circle at 92% 88%,
      rgba(255,255,255,.07),
      transparent 30%
    ),

    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0e1a27,
      #1c3043
    );
}

.cm-benefits .cm-title{
  color:#fff;
}

.cm-benefits .cm-eyebrow{
  color:#76c3f4;
}

.cm-benefits .cm-description{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
}

.cm-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:14px;

  max-width:1080px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-benefit{
  position:relative;

  min-width:0;

  padding:21px;

  border-radius:17px;

  background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.055);

  border:
    1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);

  overflow:hidden;

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    background .25s ease;
}

.cm-benefit:hover{
  transform:translateY(-4px);

  background:
    rgba(255,255,255,.09);
}

.cm-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;

  top:0;
  left:0;

  width:4px;
  height:100%;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #63b8ee,
      #1769aa
    );
}

.cm-benefit-number{
  margin-bottom:6px;

  color:#75c2f3;

  font-size:12px;

  font-weight:900;

  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.cm-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:21px;

  font-weight:900;
}

.cm-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);

  font-size:18px;

  line-height:1.58;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 DRIVING SCENES
========================================================= */

.cm-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #f8fbfd,
      #edf3f7
    );
}

.cm-scene-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:11px;

  max-width:1080px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-scene{
  padding:20px 15px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:15px;

  background:#fff;

  border:1px solid var(--cm-border);

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 17px rgba(35,55,70,.05);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease;
}

.cm-scene:hover{
  transform:translateY(-4px);
}

.cm-scene-icon{
  width:52px;
  height:52px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 10px;

  border-radius:14px;

  background:var(--cm-blue-light);

  font-size:25px;
}

.cm-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  font-size:19px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.cm-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--cm-muted);

  font-size:16px;

  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.cm-specs{
  background:#eef2f5;
}

.cm-spec-box{
  width:100%;
  max-width:980px;

  margin:0 auto;

  padding:10px;

  border-radius:20px;

  background:#fff;

  border:
    1px solid #d4dde5;

  box-shadow:
    0 12px 32px rgba(30,48,63,.07);
}

.cm-spec-row{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    34% 66%;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:10px;

  border:
    1px solid #d8e0e7;
}

.cm-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cm-spec-label{
  padding:13px 15px;

  color:#35414c;

  background:#e9eef2;

  font-size:17px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.cm-spec-value{
  padding:13px 15px;

  color:#5f6a74;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:17px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

.cm-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ffffff,
      #f5faff
    );
}

.cm-review-summary{
  max-width:760px;

  margin:-5px auto 25px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#6a747d;

  font-size:17px;

  line-height:1.6;
}

.cm-rating{
  margin-bottom:5px;

  color:#f2a93b;

  font-size:24px;

  letter-spacing:3px;
}

.cm-review-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:13px;

  max-width:1100px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-review-card{
  padding:21px;

  border-radius:17px;

  background:#fff;

  border:
    1px solid var(--cm-border);

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 18px rgba(35,50,65,.05);
}

.cm-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:8px;

  color:#f2a93b;

  font-size:16px;

  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.cm-review-card h3{
  margin:0 0 7px;

  font-size:19px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.cm-review-card p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--cm-muted);

  font-size:17px;

  line-height:1.58;
}

.cm-review-user{
  margin-top:11px;

  color:#87919a;

  font-size:14px;

  font-weight:800;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.cm-faq{
  background:#eef2f5;
}

.cm-faq-list{
  width:100%;
  max-width:960px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-faq details{
  margin-bottom:8px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:13px;

  background:#fff;

  border:
    1px solid #d6dfe6;

  box-shadow:
    0 4px 13px rgba(30,45,58,.035);
}

.cm-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.cm-faq summary{
  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;

  gap:15px;

  padding:16px 18px;

  cursor:pointer;

  list-style:none;

  color:#26323d;

  font-size:18px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.cm-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.cm-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  width:29px;
  height:29px;

  flex:0 0 29px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:#64717c;

  background:#e8edf1;

  font-size:18px;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    color .35s ease,
    background .35s ease;
}

.cm-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #2a88ce,
      #125b96
    );
}

.cm-faq-answer{
  padding:
    0 18px 18px;

  color:#66727c;

  font-size:17px;

  line-height:1.62;
}


/* =========================================================
   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
   2 × 2 DESKTOP + MOBILE
========================================================= */

.cm-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.cm-guarantee-grid{
  display:grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));

  gap:14px;

  max-width:1080px;

  margin:0 auto;
}

.cm-guarantee{
  min-width:0;

  padding:21px;

  border-radius:17px;

  border:
    1px solid var(--cm-border);

  box-shadow:
    0 6px 18px rgba(35,50,65,.05);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.cm-guarantee:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 26px rgba(35,50,65,.09);
}

.cm-guarantee:nth-child(1){
  background:#eef7ff;
}

.cm-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#f5f8fb;
}

.cm-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#f0f6f8;
}

.cm-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#eef7ff;
}

.cm-guarantee-icon{
  width:45px;
  height:45px;

  display:flex;

  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:9px;

  border-radius:12px;

  background:#fff;

  font-size:22px;

  box-shadow:
    0 4px 11px rgba(30,50,70,.06);
}

.cm-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 6px;

  font-size:19px;

  font-weight:950;
}

.cm-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--cm-muted);

  font-size:16px;

  line-height:1.52;
}


/* =========================================================
   11 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.cm-cta{
  position:relative;

  overflow:hidden;

  padding:65px 22px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:

    radial-gradient(
      circle at 10% 20%,
      rgba(46,142,213,.28),
      transparent 28%
    ),

    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(255,255,255,.07),
      transparent 30%
    ),

    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0d1927,
      #1e3348,
      #0b1622
    );
}

.cm-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 11px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:38px;

  margin:0 auto 20px;

  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 8px 22px rgba(40,70,90,.06);
}

.brm-intro-copy{
  max-width:980px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:25px 28px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:18px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #fff,
      #edf5f9
    );
}

.brm-intro-copy h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:28px;
  line-height:1.12;
  font-weight:950;
}

.brm-intro-copy h2 span{
  color:var(--blue);
}

.brm-intro-copy p{
  max-width:780px;
  margin:0 auto 16px;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:15px;
  line-height:1.58;
}

.brm-mini-points{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px;
}

.brm-mini-point{
  padding:11px 10px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#fff;
}

.brm-mini-point strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:2px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:13px;
}

.brm-mini-point span{
  color:#777f84;

  font-size:11px;
  line-height:1.38;
}


/* =========================================================
   04 DETAILED FEATURES
========================================================= */

.brm-features{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      #eaf4fa,
      #f8fbfc
    );
}

.brm-feature-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
}

.brm-feature{
  overflow:hidden;

  border-radius:15px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 16px rgba(35,65,85,.055);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.brm-feature:hover{
  transform:translateY(-2px);

  box-shadow:
    0 11px 25px rgba(35,65,85,.10);
}

.brm-feature:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff;
}

.brm-feature:nth-child(2){
  background:#eaf5fc;
}

.brm-feature:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2f4;
}

.brm-feature:nth-child(4){
  background:#eaf5f1;
}

.brm-feature-copy{
  padding:16px 18px;
}

.brm-feature h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.18;
  font-weight:950;
}

.brm-feature p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.5;
}


/* =========================================================
   05 CORE SELLING POINTS
========================================================= */

.brm-benefits{
  background:#fff;
}

.brm-benefit-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1040px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.brm-benefit{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:20px 21px 20px 24px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.brm-benefit::before{
  content:"";

  position:absolute;
  top:0;
  left:0;
  bottom:0;

  width:4px;

  background:var(--blue);
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(1){
  background:#eaf5fc;
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(2){
  background:#eaf5f1;
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(2)::before{
  background:var(--teal);
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(3){
  background:#edf2f4;
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(3)::before{
  background:var(--steel);
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff2e5;
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(4)::before{
  background:var(--orange);
}

.brm-benefit-num{
  margin-bottom:3px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(2) .brm-benefit-num{
  color:var(--teal-dark);
}

.brm-benefit:nth-child(4) .brm-benefit-num{
  color:var(--orange-dark);
}

.brm-benefit h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:950;
}

.brm-benefit p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}


/* =========================================================
   06 USE CASES
========================================================= */

.brm-scenes{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #edf7fb,
      #f7fbfa
    );
}

.brm-scene-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1060px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.brm-scene{
  padding:20px 15px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #dce6eb;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(40,65,80,.05);
}

.brm-scene-icon{
  width:44px;
  height:44px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin:0 auto 8px;

  border-radius:12px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);
  background:var(--blue-light);

  font-size:20px;
}

.brm-scene:nth-child(2) .brm-scene-icon{
  color:var(--teal-dark);
  background:var(--teal-light);
}

.brm-scene:nth-child(3) .brm-scene-icon{
  color:var(--orange-dark);
  background:var(--orange-light);
}

.brm-scene h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.brm-scene p{
  margin:0;

  color:var(--muted);

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   07 SPECIFICATIONS
========================================================= */

.brm-specs{
  background:#fff;
}

.brm-spec-box{
  max-width:970px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:8px;

  border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  background:#f4f7f9;

  box-shadow:
    0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.045);
}

.brm-spec-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:34% 66%;

  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:5px;

  border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid #dce2e6;

  background:#fff;
}

.brm-spec-row:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.brm-spec-label{
  padding:11px 13px;

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--dark);

  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.brm-spec-value{
  padding:11px 13px;

  color:#656f75;
  background:#fff;

  font-size:13px;
}


/* =========================================================
   08 CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

.brm-reviews{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #eaf5fc,
      #edf7f2
    );
}

.brm-review-note{
  max-width:800px;
  margin:-5px auto 20px;
  padding:10px 13px;

  text-align:center;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #dce4e8;

  color:#6f787d;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);

  font-size:11px;
}

.brm-review-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1060px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.brm-review{
  padding:18px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #dce4e8;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(40,65,80,.045);
}

.brm-review:nth-child(2){
  background:#eaf5f1;
}

.brm-review:nth-child(3){
  background:#fff2e5;
}

.brm-review-stars{
  margin-bottom:5px;

  color:#e28b35;

  font-size:13px;
  letter-spacing:1px;
}

.brm-review h3{
  margin:0 0 5px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.brm-review p{
  margin:0;

  color:#69747a;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.48;
}

.brm-review-user{
  margin-top:8px;

  color:#969da1;

  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.4px;
}


/* =========================================================
   09 FAQ
========================================================= */

.brm-faq{
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #edf6fb,
      #f4f8f7
    );
}

.brm-faq-list{
  max-width:930px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.brm-faq details{
  overflow:hidden;

  margin-bottom:6px;

  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid #d9e1e5;

  background:#fff;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.035);
}

.brm-faq details:last-child{
  margin-bottom:0;
}

.brm-faq summary{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;

  padding:14px 16px;

  cursor:pointer;
  list-style:none;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.brm-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{
  display:none;
}

.brm-faq summary::after{
  content:"⌄";

  flex:0 0 27px;

  width:27px;
  height:27px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  border-radius:50%;

  color:var(--blue-dark);
  background:var(--blue-light);

  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;

  transition:
    transform .35s ease,
    background .35s ease,
    color .35s ease;
}

.brm-faq details[open] summary::after{
  transform:rotate(180deg);

  color:#fff;
  background:var(--blue-dark);
}

.brm-faq-answer{
  padding:0 16px 14px;

  color:#68737a;

  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}


/* =========================================================
   10 FOUR GUARANTEES
========================================================= */

.brm-guarantees{
  background:#fff;
}

.brm-guarantee-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:9px;

  max-width:1050px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

.brm-guarantee{
  padding:18px;

  border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);

  box-shadow:
    0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(1){
  background:#edf3f5;
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(2){
  background:#eaf5fc;
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(3){
  background:#eaf5f1;
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(4){
  background:#fff2e5;
}

.brm-guarantee-icon{
  width:39px;
  height:39px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  margin-bottom:7px;

  border-radius:10px;

  color:var(--blue-dark);
  background:#fff;

  font-size:19px;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.055);
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(2) .brm-guarantee-icon{
  color:var(--blue-dark);
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(3) .brm-guarantee-icon{
  color:var(--teal-dark);
}

.brm-guarantee:nth-child(4) .brm-guarantee-icon{
  color:var(--orange-dark);
}

.brm-guarantee h3{
  margin:0 0 4px;

  color:var(--black);

  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:950;
}

.brm-guarantee p{
  margin:0;

  color:#68747a;

  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.45;
}


/* =========================================================
   11 FINAL CTA
========================================================= */

.brm-cta{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;

  padding:55px 20px;

  text-align:center;

  color:#fff;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 8% 20%,
      rgba(47,128,201,.30),
      transparent 25%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 80%,
      rgba(61,156,138,.23),
      transparent 27%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #142633,
      #21445c,
      #274c4a
    );
}

.brm-cta h2{
  margin:0 0 9px;

  color:#fff;

  font-size:39px;
  line-height:1.08;
  font-weight:950;
  letter-spacing:-1px;
}

.brm-cta h2 span{
  color:#79cef2;
}

.brm-cta p{
  max-width:680px;
  margin:0 auto 20px;

  color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);

  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.55;
}

.brm-btn{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:49px;
  padding:0 27px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff !important;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ef9346,
      #d8752e
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 9px 23px rgba(0,0,0,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.brm-btn:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.02);

  box-shadow:
    0 15px 31px rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}

.brm-btn:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOATING BUY NOW
========================================================= */

.brm-floating-buy{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:99999;

  right:16px;
  bottom:16px;

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

  min-height:48px;
  padding:0 20px;

  border-radius:999px;

  color:#fff !important;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #ef9346,
      #d8752e
    );

  text-decoration:none;

  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:950;

  box-shadow:
    0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.28);

  transition:
    transform .25s ease,
    box-shadow .25s ease;
}

.brm-floating-buy:hover{
  transform:
    translateY(-3px)
    scale(1.03);

  box-shadow:
    0 16px 33px rgba(0,0,0,.36);
}

.brm-floating-buy:active{
  transform:scale(.90);
}

Charge the unit before first use. Mount it where the top solar panel receives good sunlight; use USB charging as a backup during setup or prolonged cloudy weather.
Is it waterproof?
The product is listed as IP55 rated, meaning it is intended for normal outdoor exposure to dust and water jets. It is not designed for submersion; keep charging ports properly closed.
Where should I install it?
Mount it facing the path animals or visitors are most likely to use, with a clear sensor view and sunlight reaching the solar panel. Avoid pointing it toward busy sidewalks, roads, neighbors’ property or constantly moving branches.
Is 130 dB safe at close range?
High sound levels can harm hearing. Do not activate it close to people, pets or wildlife ears. Test at low volume from a safe distance, increase only as needed and follow local ordinances.

Ordinary soft bait may look stiff, carry no added scent or tear while being threaded. This lure combines multiple attraction and handling features in one compact worm body.

A lure that hangs straight and lifeless can produce a less natural presentation. Fragile soft plastic can also split around the hook before you have finished fishing the spot.

Multi-Cue Soft Bait

Function-by-Function Breakdown

Shrimp Scent Adds More Than Visual Attraction 🦐

The scented body adds an odor cue to the worm-style profile. That gives fish another way to investigate the presentation beyond color and movement alone.

Useful when you want a compact soft bait with both visual action and added scent.
02 • Water Action

Segmented Ribs Flex with Small Movements 〰️

The narrow ribbed sections bend along the lure body instead of moving as one stiff piece. Current, rod-tip motion and retrieval can produce a more animated worm-style presentation.

03 • Low-Light Visibility

The product is designed with a glow effect that makes the lure easier to see in darker water or lower-light periods. Charge and brightness can vary with prior light exposure and conditions.

The TPR body can stretch as it is threaded onto a compatible hook, then flex during the retrieve. This makes it more forgiving to handle than a rigid imitation worm.

The resilient material is designed to return toward its shape after stretching and to stay positioned on a properly threaded hook. Inspect each lure after bites or snags and replace it when damaged.
